name: Flourish 1
price_note: first batch of 50 units, deliveries from December 2026; advanced AI features need the owner's GPU or a company plan
summary: A deliberately light, cheap home robot: two arms with grippers above a wheeled base, with an upper body that moves vertically. Owners teach it chores with a smartphone. At US$3,555 it is the lowest-priced semi-humanoid in the index, with clear limits: a 1.5 kg payload, no stairs, and a warning against handling breakables.
notable: Lowest advertised price for a full-height semi-humanoid (2026)
